verdict.rationale: VPM's own docs say it acts as registered agent, receiving service of process, legal notices, and state correspondence. The service is 'Included FREE with all virtual mailbox plans,' so it is bundled with the mailbox account. Served documents are scanned the same day, stored as PDFs in the cloud, and trigger real-time email alerts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on which states are covered and how the registered agent address relates to the mailbox address.
